notes: Card: ' and' x5 and ' и', plus digits inside '(84%)' figures. Probe: 'three in Texas and two' 0.54, Russian equivalent 0.52; 'Texas and Wisconsin'-like joins not probed directly; digits in '(84%)' scored erratically (0.04-0.78), so percentages are left out of the claim.
